LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray.label: Crown Scission Array
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray.description: A crown-engineered severance pincer built around a wound-core that remembers completed motion. Direct hostile kills leave a short-lived echo inside the array; the next confirmed cut can force that stored trajectory through one nearby enemy before the mechanism forgets what it was made to repeat.
